verdict.rationale: Okta offers its own testing environments: the Okta Integrator Free Plan is pitched for testing code and apps, and the XAA playground lets users explore Cross App Access end-to-end with no infrastructure to set up. However, the evidence never says these are isolated from production orgs or production data, and nothing documents sandbox parity or how agents/MCP would target them. missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolation from production data, sandbox-to-production parity or promotion details, agent/MCP sandbox targeting, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Access the Okta Integrator Free Plan
Test your code and apps, as well as manage and automate Okta for employees and partners.
a free, open playground that lets you explore Cross App Access end-to-end.
